Who is Spitfire?

Annituuli Kasurinen (Finnish, seasons 2-3)Stephane Flamand (French, season 1)Elsa Poisot (French, season 3 onwards)Anita Hopt (German, seasons 1-2)Marie-Luise Schramm (German, season 3 onwards)Lauren Savir (Hebrew)Deborah Morese (Italian, season 1)Gea Riva (Italian, S2E22)Tania De Domenico (Italian, seasons 3-5)Maria Grazia Errigo (Italian, S6E7)Yumi Uchiyama (Japanese)Yoon Mi-na (Korean)Noorhayati Maslini Omar (Malaysian, S1E16)Tomasz Jarosz (Polish, season 1)Anna Sztejner (Polish, seasons 3 onwards)Celso Alves (Brazilian Portuguese, S1E16)Márcio Marconatto (Brazilian Portuguese, S1E26)Jussara Marques (Brazilian Portuguese, S2E22)Fernanda Bullara (Brazilian Portuguese, season 3)Gabriela Codrea (Romanian, seasons 1-2)Alina Leonte (Romanian, season 3)Cosmin Petrut (Romanian, season 4)Olga Shorokhova (Russian, seasons 1, 3 and 5)Olga Golovanova (Russian, season 4)Anneli Heed (Swedish, from S1E26 onward)Gabriela Guzman (Latin American Spanish, seasons 1, 2, 4, and 6 onward)Dulce Guerrero (Latin American Spanish, season 3)Laura Torres (Latin American Spanish, season 5)Sumita Thaijamnong (Thai)Alisa Huryeva (Ukrainian, seasons 5-6)

Spitfire is a female Pegasus pony and the captain of the Wonderbolts. She has her first speaking role in Sonic Rainboom but isn't named until The Best Night Ever. The term "spitfire" may refer either to a person with a fierce temper or to the iconic British fighter aircraft used in the Second World War.__TOC__

In the episode Hurricane Fluttershy, Rainbow Dash mentions that Spitfire is the captain of the Wonderbolts. Later in the episode, she supervises the other Pegasus ponies as they create a waterspout to deliver water to Cloudsdale and seems impressed by their efforts, even though they did not break the record.

Rainbow Dash confronts Spitfire about Lightning Dust's recklessness, and proceeds to quit the academy when Spitfire doesn't challenge her claims. Spitfire, however, is angry, claiming that she was not given a chance to respond, catches up with her, and tells Dash that being a Wonderbolt is about "pushing yourself in the right direction", which Dash has shown her she can do. She makes Rainbow Dash the team leader, stripping Lightning Dust of her rank.
